root@400c443fb1a5:/app# cat > /app/curl.py << 'EOF'
> #!/usr/bin/env python3
> import sys
> import urllib.request
> import urllib.error
>
> def fetch(url, timeout=10):
>     req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "robust-curl/1.0"})
>     try:
>         with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
>             resp.read()
>             return resp.status
>     except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
>         # Server answered, but with a 4xx/5xx status.
>         return e.code
>     except Exception as e:
>         # Transport-level failure: DNS resolution error, connection refused,
>         # socket timeout, SSL error, etc. Report '000' like curl does
>         # instead of letting the script die with a traceback.
>         sys.stderr.write("transport error: %s\n" % e)
>         return 0
>
> def main(argv):
>     if len(argv) < 2:
>         sys.stderr.write("usage: python3 curl.py URL\n")
>         return 2
>     code = fetch(argv[1])
>     if code == 0:
>         print("000")
>     else:
>         print(code)
>
> if __name__ == "__main__":
>     sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
> EOF

root@400c443fb1a5:/app# cat > /app/curl.py << 'EOF'
> #!/usr/bin/env python3
> import sys
> import urllib.request
> import urllib.error
>
> def fetch(url, timeout=5):
>     req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "robust-curl/1.0"})
>     try:
>         with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
>             resp.read()
>             return resp.status
>     except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
>         # Server answered with a 4xx/5xx status.
>         return e.code
>     except Exception as e:
>         # Transport-level failure: DNS resolution error, connection refused,
>         # socket timeout, SSL error, etc. Report '000' like curl -w http_code
>         # instead of dying with a Python traceback.
>         sys.stderr.write("transport error: %s\n" % e)
>         return 0
>
> def main(argv):
>     if len(argv) < 2:
>         sys.stderr.write("usage: python3 curl.py URL\n")
>         return 2
>     code = fetch(argv[1])
>     print("000" if code == 0 else code)
>     return 0
>
> if __name__ == "__main__":
>     sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
> EOF
